paras: Columbus-based, operating out of 614Sneaker on North High Street — trading cards sitting inside a sneaker shop.
An unusual crossover, and a reminder that the pop-culture side of this floor is not an afterthought.

ig.name: 614Rips
ig.bio: Buy, sell, trade. Premium trading cards available exclusively at 614Sneaker, 970 N. High Street, Columbus Ohio.

paras: Michigan-based and focused on local and Detroit teams.
A newer operation, which on a show floor often means keener pricing and more willingness to deal.

ig.name: Backyard Cards MI
ig.bio: Sports card collecting, based in Michigan. Passionate about local and Detroit sports. Buying, selling and trading.

paras: The biggest social following on the floor by a distance — 17,000 on Instagram and another 45,000 on TikTok — run out of a shop four blocks from Sox Park in Chicago.
They post that they are always buying grails, singles and slabs. Travelling this far for a Michigan show usually means bringing inventory worth the trip.

ig.name: Bridgeport Hobby
ig.bio: Cards, content and breaks. Shop four blocks from Sox Park in Chicago. Always buying grails, singles and slabs. 45.4k on TikTok.

paras: Exhibiting at RazMania. Their Instagram presence is minimal, so we have not seen enough public activity to write a fuller view.
Worth walking past rather than planning around — plenty of good tables keep no social footprint at all.
A bricks-and-mortar shop in Shelby Township that brings a store's depth to a show table — 527 posts and 2,400 followers deep, with buy, sell and trade all advertised equally.
If you are bringing a collection to sell rather than a want list to fill, a dealer with a real storefront behind them is usually the easier conversation.

ig.name: DETROIT LEGENDS SPORTS
ig.bio: LCS STORE 55226 Van Dyke, Shelby Twp., Michigan 48316, join our discord server below! BUY - SELL - TRADE

paras: Waterford-based, working shows across Michigan, with slabs, singles and mystery bags.
Advertises buying collections outright. Worth a conversation if you are clearing a box rather than filling a binder.

ig.name: Diesel's Dugout
ig.bio: Buy, Sell, Trade Sports Cards. Waterford, MI. Shows across Michigan. Slabs, singles, mystery bags. Always buying collections.

paras: A father-and-son operation with an active eBay storefront and 2,200 followers.
Sellers with a running eBay history price against comps rather than against hope, which usually makes for a faster negotiation.

ig.name: DJsportscards
ig.bio: Dylan and Jesse Heber. Always looking to buy, sell and trade.

paras: Michigan vendor covering football, basketball and Disney, and a tournament host on the side.
The Disney run is the unusual part — almost nobody else on this floor carries it.

ig.name: Dude Digz Cards
ig.bio: Michigan card vendor. Football, basketball, Disney. FGC tournament host. Host of GOAT Debates.

paras: Michigan TCG vendor and a Lucario collector, which tells you where the specialist knowledge sits.
Small table, specific expertise. Ask them about the thing they actually collect.
An authorised PSA Elite Dealer out of Macomb Township, running group submissions for both PSA and PSA Autograph.

That makes this the table to visit if you are carrying raw cards you want graded. Bring the cards and the questions — group submissions are the cheapest route into PSA most collectors will find at a show.

ig.name: Harvbo Cards LLC — PSA Authorized Dealer
ig.bio: Macomb Twp., MI. Authorized PSA Elite Dealer. PSA and PSA Autograph group submissions. DM for grading or authentication questions.

paras: Michigan Pokémon dealer working the card-show circuit: slabs, singles and sealed, buy, sell and trade.
A show-circuit regular rather than a shopfront, which usually means sharper prices and a tighter, more curated case.

ig.name: Anthony
ig.bio: Card Shows · Pokémon Cards · Slabs, Singles, Sealed · Buy, Sell, Trade · Michigan

paras: One Piece and Pokémon, 700 posts deep, with a YouTube channel alongside the shop.
One Piece is the thinnest category on most Midwest floors, so if that is what you collect this is likely your only real stop.

ig.name: MMD Cards
ig.bio: One Piece and Pokémon. Cards, cards, cards. Enjoy the hobby.

paras: Verified Michigan Pokémon vendor running sealed, singles, hits, mystery boxes and grab bags.
Broad enough to cover a beginner and a chase-hunter at the same table, which is rarer than it sounds in the TCG corner of a show floor.

ig.name: Joe
ig.bio: Vendor and lifelong collector. Sealed, singles, hits, mystery boxes, grab bags. Michigan. Buy, sell and trade.

paras: Michigan Pokémon dealer working the show circuit.
Newer to Instagram than to the hobby — worth stopping by rather than judging by follower count.
A newer Pokémon vendor, honest about being early in the journey.
New vendors are often where the underpriced singles are, precisely because they are still building a reputation.

ig.name: Tom
ig.bio: Fresh vendor trying to collect em all.

paras: Pops, prints and Pokémon — the clearest non-sports table on the floor.
If you are bringing kids, or you collect outside cardboard entirely, this is where to start.
A card-show regular that leans on grails and atmosphere in equal measure.
Check their pinned post before the show — they publish what they are bringing.

ig.name: Salmo Bros Collectibles
ig.bio: Bringing the heat to your local card shows. Rare grails, the best vibes. Catch us at the next event.

paras: A Crestwood, Illinois shop built around community as much as inventory — open six days, with play space alongside the cases.
Pokémon, memorabilia and sports under one banner, so it covers more of a want list than a single-category table.

ig.name: Secret Lair Collectibles
ig.bio: Crestwood's lair for collectibles and community. Tue–Fri 12–8, Sat 11–8, Sun 11–5. 13111 Rivercrest Dr, Crestwood IL 60418. Buy, sell, trade, play.

paras: Modern and vintage across all sports, buying and selling both.
A generalist table, which is exactly what you want when your want list crosses eras.

ig.name: John Castiglione
ig.bio: Always buying, selling and trading all sports cards, modern and vintage era.

paras: Verified, nearly 4,000 followers, and a YouTube channel built on filming the actual negotiations rather than just the pulls.
A dealer who publishes their deal-making tends to price consistently, because the footage is the reputation. Expect to be able to talk numbers.

ig.name: Stoney Sports Vault
ig.bio: Real sports card deals. Real negotiations. Real stories from the road. Buying, selling, trading. New videos every week.

paras: A Shelby Township storefront that opened in July, open seven days a week noon to eight.
New shops tend to arrive at shows with fresh inventory and something to prove. Worth a look early in the day.

ig.name: The Card Cave MI
ig.bio: Buy, sell, trade. Store hours Tuesday–Sunday 12–8. 8242 23 Mile Rd, Shelby Twp.
